definitions.GH: time-ordered two-time set C_ab = P_b(+T) P_a(-T) conditioned on the turnaround state psi0; D(h,h') = <C_h' psi0|C_h psi0>
definitions.linear: q_ab = Re<psi0|E+_b E-_a|psi0> = Re Tr(C_ab rho0) (Goldstein-Page Eq. 10-12; Margenau-Hill)

headline.GH_diag_law: D(in,in) = P1^3/w0^2 (R_G range [0.9999961478926724, 1.000094782174654]); below Frechet lower bound for P1 > 0.618
headline.linear_law: P2_lin = P1^2/w0 (R_K range [0.9999297542470542, 1.0000020573003805]); inside Frechet band; all four cells >= 0

crit_as0p1180.offset_formula: Delta m = -ln2 / <d ln(-ln P1)/dm_t> (P2 = P1^2 doubles the integrated hazard)

ranges.note: u_T >= 1, all states / m_t / numerical variants
